description: This file is a shell test script for testing Git's directory rename detection during various rebase and apply operations. It sets up test repositories, performs actions such as renaming directories, and verifies if Git correctly detects the renaming, especially in different rebase modes.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Initializes a new test Git repository with a specific directory structure.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Outputs a sequence of numbers within a specified range.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that should succeed when executed.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be run after tests.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file matches expected count.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a given path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a given path does not exist.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Sets up a fake editor environment for testing interactive rebase.
